subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw-owned agent and tool surfaces keep shortening real home-contained paths, or should they render full absolute paths by default?
rationale: Current main and tests intentionally preserve home-relative display, so changing it is a visible UX contract choice rather than a narrow regression fix.

options.title: Switch to absolute defaults
options.body: Update shared display helpers, prompt guidance, and tests so agent-visible file paths under home render as full absolute paths consistently.

options.title: Keep shorthand default
options.body: Preserve compact home-relative output and limit fixes to malformed or non-copyable path corruption cases.

options.title: Add explicit full-path mode
options.body: Keep the current default and add a documented opt-in setting only if maintainers want compatibility-preserving user choice.

recommendation.title: Switch to absolute defaults
recommendation.body: Update shared display helpers, prompt guidance, and tests so agent-visible file paths under home render as full absolute paths consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared display helper contract and current carried behavior trace most directly through this history, making this the best available routing owner for the product decision.
